name: test
description: Run tests, check coverage, and fix failures. Load test-engineer persona.

steps.prompt: Load the test-driven-development skill and test-engineer agent persona
Run the full test suite and report results. Identify failed tests, flaky tests, and coverage gaps
For each failure: diagnose root cause, fix the code (not the test), verify fix with test re-run
Check coverage meets threshold (>= 80%). Add tests for uncovered critical paths. Reference testing-patterns.md for patterns
Review tests for anti-patterns: testing implementation details, over-mocking, missing edge cases
